zone.label: Watch zone
zone.action: The setup has constructive pieces, but it is below the accumulation threshold.

signals.label: Payroll cooling
signals.detail: Slower payroll growth has historically been one of the cleaner macro backdrops for better forward gold returns.

signals.label: Dollar pressure
signals.detail: A weaker dollar reduces headwind for gold because gold is priced globally in USD.

signals.label: 10Y yield pressure
signals.detail: Falling or stable long rates reduce the opportunity-cost pressure that often weighs on gold.

signals.label: Gold momentum
signals.detail: Positive three-month momentum confirms that buyers are already supporting the trend.

signals.label: Inflation expectation level
signals.detail: The historical analysis showed very high breakeven inflation levels were not automatically better entry points.

signals.label: Trend health vs 52W high
signals.detail: A smaller drawdown from the 52-week high keeps the trend-health signal constructive.

nextForecast.model: Persistence baseline: tomorrow score = latest available score

methodology: Use a compact set of six interpretable signals instead of the full feature table.
Convert the latest value of each signal into its historical percentile.
Flip the percentile when lower values are historically more bullish for gold.
Weight the signals into a 0-100 Gold Timing Score.
Treat 70+ as the accumulation threshold; below that, keep the page in watch or caution mode.
